bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: Standard technical analysis textbooks teach traders to wait for three higher highs and lower lows before drawing static channels; by the time this is confirmed, the trend is already reaching a climax and entering distribution.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: By the time a trader waits for three confirmation points to draw lines, the market has already progressed through the technical trend-following stage and is reaching a climax... getting in when smart money is getting out.

facts.statement: Trends do not start in mid-air; they are born and propelled directly out of support and resistance price congestion zones where smart money completes accumulation or distribution campaigns.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Trends do not start in mid-air; they are born and propelled out of support and resistance (price congestion) zones. These consolidation areas represent where smart money completes accumulation or distribution campaigns.

facts.statement: Dynamic trendlines are constructed in real-time as price breaks out from congestion: an uptrend breakout forms a pivot high on pullback, followed by a low-volume pivot low, which sets subsequent higher highs and higher lows.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Dynamic trendlines are constructed in real-time as price breaks out from congestion, using isolated pivot markers to define boundaries while holding an active position... breakout forms first marker (pivot high), pullback forms second marker (pivot low).

facts.statement: Every wave higher in an uptrend must be supported by rising volume, whereas counter-trend pullbacks must show low or declining volume to confirm that selling pressure is light and the pullback is temporary.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Every wave higher in an uptrend must be supported by rising volume, while counter-trend pullbacks must show low or declining volume.

facts.statement: If a new pivot high forms at the same level as or lower than a previous pivot high, the market is stalling into secondary congestion; a downside breakout signals an immediate trend reversal and exit.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: If a new pivot high forms at the same level as (or lower than) a previous pivot high, the market is stalling into a secondary congestion phase. A breakout to the downside signals an immediate trend reversal and exit.

facts.statement: Coulling compares multi-timeframe analysis to driving on a three-lane highway with wing mirrors: the fast timeframe acts as the left mirror for micro-changes, the middle timeframe is the execution chart, and the slow timeframe is the right mirror for broader structure.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Coulling compares trading with three timeframe charts to driving on a three-lane highway with wing mirrors: fast lane (5-min), middle lane (15-min execution chart), slow lane (30-min/60-min broader structure).

facts.statement: A sentiment change or trend reversal starts small in the fast timeframe, acting like a pebble dropped in a pond where ripples spread outward to slower timeframes until the trend is fully confirmed.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Like a pebble dropped in a pond, the initial price/volume anomaly creates ripples that spread outward from the fastest chart to the primary chart, and finally to the slow timeframe.

facts.statement: Due to cause and effect, a trend reversal that takes time to build and ripple across timeframes accumulates greater energy like a fully wound clockwork model car, resulting in a move that travels further with greater momentum.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A trend reversal that takes time to build and ripple across fast, medium, and slow timeframes accumulates greater energy—much like fully winding a clockwork model car.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
